name: Wix Payments
line: Integrated payments, recurring charges, and payment links for Wix sites.

free.text: Requires a Wix Core or higher plan; processing fees apply

cells.countries: 15 countries incl. US, UK, Germany; no India
cells.payout: First funds ~7 days; bank adds 3–5 days

fee.math: The rate for cards from the US. American Express costs 3.7% plus $0.30.
The rate for cards from the UK. American Express costs 3.1% plus £0.20.
The rate for Germany and nine other listed EU countries. American Express costs 3.1% plus €0.30.
India isn't one of the 15 published seller countries.
